name: Sivakumar
comment: Absolutely addictive! The bot is tough but fair. Best word game I've played in a while.

name: Suja
comment: Love the multiplayer mode. Connecting via room codes is super fast. Ideally needs a 'Rematch' button.

name: Ram
comment: The 'Find Word' mode using AI definitions is genius. It really tests your vocabulary depth. Highly recommend!

name: Geetha
comment: Good game logic, but 30 seconds in Single Player feels too short when you are stuck on a hard letter like 'X'.

name: Adhvik
comment: Simple interface, no ads interrupting constantly. The neon dark theme looks amazing on my phone.
